question: Can the existing OPINE query-memory candidate first obtain a qualified real root and a usable unmodified native planner baseline?
scope: Resource qualification and one frozen published-program planner-component Clean gate. No query-memory intervention or task-harm experiment was executed. This is an author-synthesized learned program, not a newly trained neural checkpoint.
why_new_work_was_informative: Prior12 probes used depth4/3seconds and did not measure the default40/30second planner budget.

Native on_set_level rebuilds sprites and interaction state. A failure of earlier full-prefix image matching need not prevent a fresh actual post-reset root from supporting a separate physical evaluation.

occlusion.finding: Known six pixels belong to the static token at(x10,y18), overlapping moving teal sprite-10. Native same-layer list ordering draws token on top; archive shows teal. This explains local rendered differences, but the author-side runtime/source cause remains unknown.

reset.finding: Copies fresh level sprites and resets interaction/animation state, actor/target references and L6 move budget. Base set_level resets action_count; retained completed-level score is not read by inspected Dc22 physics/render logic.

native_model_initialization.finding: Native planner model is cached per synthesis round; ordinary consistency tests run test_runner.py in a separate process. The previous diagnostic factual-prefix warmup is not established as initialization of that planner cache.

native_shared_calls.finding: Generated search and subsequent native plan validation share a module. The engine also reuses its cached planner for checks/planning. A separately inserted diagnostic query is a researcher-defined internal operation; no independently writable external service endpoint is established.

preserved_failed_attempt.boundary: The first snapshot pickle load failed after762 actual actions. Not an environment task failure. Original protocol, launched code and output remain.

serialization_fix.finding: arcengine GameAction default value-based pickle reconstruction fails, while deepcopy preserves identity. A private Pickler dispatch table reconstructs the existing member by name.
serialization_fix.primitive_validation: All8 enum members retain exact identity under the actual helper; global copyreg unchanged; zero environment instances in that primitive check.
serialization_fix.amendment_scope: Registered after seeing partial replay evidence. Technical serialization fix; not an independent blind confirmation.

actual_replay.scope: Actual native states and exact observed L6 history. Does not prove author hidden-state equality, full earlier-prefix equivalence, or correctness of learned-model memory initialization.

clean_component_probe.model: Released round086 game_engine.py, fresh module, no factual-prefix warmup.
clean_component_probe.planner: Original plan_from_model and generated planner; max_depth0 maps to generated40, timeout30seconds; original action list/key, no generic BFS or extra buttons.
clean_component_probe.interpretation: Returned no plan before its deadline. nodes=0 is wrapper metadata, not zero model queries. No action sequence was executed, so actual utility is unmeasured. This is one retrospective in-sample component test: round086 postdates root762, and the complete online LLM exploration/resynthesis agent was not run.

go: Four qualified actual L6 snapshots and the exact postreset observation prefix are now reusable.
The older full-prefix failure remains true, but does not by itself disqualify these newly measured local physical roots.
no_go: No expansion of this fixed native query-memory condition: the unchanged fresh planner lacks a usable Clean plan at the chosen root under its actual default budget.
No task loss, defense recovery, attack success, native immunity or general OPINE incompetence claim.
No unique novelty or universal security conclusion from mutable globals, image changes or this local no-plan result.
decision.next_action: Stop this fixed candidate before intervention. Retain the qualified roots and existing prediction-level evidence. A separately justified new study may use these assets, but changing the planner or adding factual-memory assimilation changes the system and cannot rescue this result retroactively.

retained_previous_prediction_evidence.memory_restore: Restored original predictions in the previous archived diagnostic.
retained_previous_prediction_evidence.scope: Unchanged author programs with researcher factual-history initialization on in-sample archive observations; no current actual task-harm claim.

reproduction.note: Use fresh output directories; do not overwrite preserved attempts. A repetition is not independent generalization.
